classification: Prospective for new generative-query-update outcomes, but not a pristine new dataset confirmation because the NQ-GTE validation pool and prior ANN trajectory results were observed in ARC-v0.27/v0.28.

primary_estimand.definition: Within query, H3abs is the OLS slope over t=0..4 of |nDCG@10_high(t)-nDCG@10_low(t)|. The primary contrast is representation H3abs minus search-effort H3abs.
primary_estimand.name: agent_H3abs_representation_minus_search_effort

retention_rule: Positive transfer, null, reversal, weaker effects, stronger effects, or qualitatively different agent behavior must all be retained. No prompt, model, ANN comparator, horizon, primary endpoint, or query subset may be retuned after main-agent outcomes begin.

sampling.selection: deterministic SHA-256 ordering of query IDs

scientific_goal: Test whether the mechanism-conditioned ANN feedback boundary transfers from centroid-style dense feedback to a frozen generative query-rewrite agent.
secondary: semantic query-state divergence slope between L/H generated queries
same-evidence generation repeat audit on smoke queries
representation-vs-search difference in agent rewrite divergence

statistics.policy_aggregation: not applicable; one frozen agent policy

title: Frozen Generative Retrieval-Agent Transfer
